'''Aran son of [[Malan]] son of [[Senar]]''' was an [[Ogier]] writer who lived shortly after the [[Breaking of the World]].

==History==
Aran was noted for his strict honesty, and his unwillingness to cite any sources that he could not verify.

Aran was the first to suggest that [[Ishamael]] had only been partially trapped in the [[Bore]] when [[Lews Therin Telamon]] and the [[Hundred Companions]] sealed the [[Dark One]]'s prison. In his manuscripts, he quotes [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai]] who lived during the [[Breaking of the World]] who claimed there were sightings of Ishamael after the Bore was sealed. 

His manuscript was never completed, but the last pages suggest that Aran had become doubtful of his own thesis towards the end of his research.{{ref/book|bwb}}
